title: MACsec-IP-360 Product Brief
summary: The MACsec-IP-360 is a purpose-built product, delivering the best area and latency for 10Mbit ports. It is a fully compliant MACsec solution and supports VLAN-in-clear case. It has all necessary functionality to autonomously protect a full port or multiple VLAN-based flows and count all required statistics. The IP comes in different variants that are tailored to customer requirements for the number of secure connections and other specific features. The feature set is compliant with the Open Alliance Automotive MACsec profile.
